title: Jayashan Manodya
organisations: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology
executive_summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence, focused on building intelligent technologies. He has developed various AI-powered projects, including a personalized nutrition assistant, a conversational shopping agent, and a document question-answering system, while continuously improving his skills through hands-on projects and modern software engineering practices.

section_summaries.summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate with a passion for AI engineering, focusing on generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent technologies.
Currently pursuing a BSc (Hons) in IT specializing in Artificial Intelligence at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology with a high GPA.
Jayashan has developed multiple AI-powered projects, including NutriLens AI, KIKO, IKMS, PlateX, WeatherLK, and TeaPlanter, utilizing various technologies.
Part-time Creative Designer at Glanz Digital, involved in designing marketing materials and collaborating on digital campaigns.
Proficient in multiple programming languages, frameworks, AI/ML tools, databases, and deployment technologies.
Completed various certifications in AI, programming, web development, and digital marketing.
Recognized for academic excellence and participation in competitions, including being a Dean's List recipient.
Includes contacts for Mr. Amila Nuwan Alexander and Mr. Bhanuka Edirisinghe from SLIIT.

important_facts: Jayashan is an IT undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence.
He has a GPA of 3.93/4.0 in his most recent semester.
He is developing an AI-powered nutrition assistant under the Ascentic AI Launch Pad mentorship program.
He has worked on various AI projects including KIKO, IKMS, and PlateX.
He is currently a part-time Creative Designer at Glanz Digital.
